request.description:
Login with email and password. Automatically saves accessToken and refreshToken to collection variables.

Pre-seeded accounts:
- demo@example.com / demo123
- admin@example.com / Password123!
- user1@example.com / Password123!
Verify email address with OTP code received during registration.

Resend OTP code for email verification or password reset.

OTP Types:
- VERIFY: Email verification
- RESET: Password reset
- LOGIN: Login OTP (if enabled)
Request password reset OTP. Response is same whether email exists or not (security best practice).
Reset password with OTP code received from forgot-password endpoint.
